name: Phaseshift
description: One ruling whose phase slides across the sheet, so the bands walk sideways as you read.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0 @calc(2 + 9 * @x / @X)%, #000 0 @calc(9 + 9 * @x / @X)%, transparent 0 18%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0 @calc(2 + 9 * @x / @X)%, #000 0 @calc(9 + 9 * @x / @X)%, transparent 0 18%); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
